custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Initials Avatar in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  5. Read the avatar beside Theresa Webb's name in her group header.
  6. Click the Column Selection button in the toolbar (tooltip "Column Selection").
  7. Tick Assigned Techs.
  8. Read the avatar group in the [WO-1] row.
  9. In the display switcher click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  10. Read the avatar beside Theresa Webb's name in her column header.
  11. Click Fields to display in the toolbar.
  12. Turn line technicians on.
  13. Read the avatar group on the [WO-1] card.
